replacement_nodes.title: Build and Fresh-L2 accept V20 bound-path repair
replacement_nodes.objective: Construct a distinct immutable V20 static exactly-once package that preserves the accepted V18 25-record binding and V19 numerical semantics while closing every production preflight path and package-key defect before any authority exists.
required_implementation: Generate all V20 files additively; preserve V19 package, acceptance, owner claim, terminal, and all predecessor roots byte-identically.
Bind the existing V17 core manifest path and hash exactly as frozen in this batch; do not derive a nonexistent V19-named core manifest path.

Use one canonical package key for core imports throughout builder, package, launcher, worker, fixture, schemas, and verifier. The accepted package must not contain a production subscript for an absent key such as frozen_core_imports.

Factor read-only production preflight into a shared routine used by the future launcher and marker-free fixture before owner, authority, credential, ledger, payload, evaluator, result, or terminal effects.

Enumerate every launcher-bound regular file, directory, interpreter, argv, cwd, environment entry, package key, and expected hash/mode. The inert verifier must prove that the shared preflight reaches every enumerated binding and rejects one deterministic mutation for each binding class.

Add AST or equivalent source analysis proving every constant-key package subscript on the production path exists in the canonical package and every bound path constant is covered by the shared preflight fixture.

Retain atomic owner claim, cardinality-one authority and credential, one payload-open boundary, one evaluator invocation, owner-only terminal publication, loser exclusion, and preconsumption versus postconsumption retirement semantics.
Run only synthetic non-sensitive fixtures. They must not open, deserialize, inspect, hash-open, or execute the official sealed tensor and must not start the official evaluator or transport.
Obtain Fresh-L2 static acceptance with decision ACCEPT_STATIC_PACKAGE and claim boundary STATIC_ONLY_NO_EXECUTION_AUTHORITY after an acceptance-aware inert rerun.
replacement_nodes.acceptance_check: Fresh-L2 accepts the immutable V20 static package after independently reproducing complete launcher-bound path/hash/mode coverage, complete production package-key coverage, the exact 25-record/3-tensor numerical binding, deterministic race/failure fixtures, zero official payload opens, zero official evaluator or target starts, absent V20 runtime state, and byte-identical V19/predecessor preservation.

replacement_nodes.title: Execute Fresh-L2 accepted V20 once
replacement_nodes.objective: After separate fresh operator authority, invoke the exact Fresh-L2 accepted V20 transport once, preserve the immutable result or structured terminal, and obtain Fresh Reviewer classification without replay, repair, fallback, or a second credential.
required_preconditions: The V20 static package and Fresh-L2 acceptance hashes are final and recorded by the completed dependency.
The declared V20 runtime namespace is absent and canonical read-only preflight passes before any authority or credential materialization.
A distinct one-use operator authority explicitly names the V20 action ID, accepted package hash, acceptance hash, interpreter, argv, cwd, environment, and runtime namespace.
No V19 path, action, authority, credential, terminal, or runtime file is reused or modified.
replacement_nodes.acceptance_check: Fresh Reviewer verifies that the sole V20 invocation produced a schema-valid G8/G4/G2/G1 Base result bound to the exact accepted package and frozen benchmark identities, with no replay or fallback. A structured terminal failure is preserved honestly but does not satisfy this node and must return to replan.

prohibited_actions: retry, replay, resume, repair, replace in place, mutate, or reinterpret the retired V19 action or runtime
create a V20 runtime namespace, owner claim, authority, credential, ledger, result, terminal, attempt marker, or execution marker in a Planner cycle
invoke any V20 transport, launcher, evaluator, model, official payload, or G8/G4/G2/G1 sweep before the execution node receives fresh authority
alter the evaluator, official inputs, candidate order, hard gates, score policy, result schema, or numerical tensor selection
modify RTL, verification references, constraints, certified PPA evidence, research/PIPELINE_STATE.json, current_stage, XRT, FPGA, HBM2, or U280 state
claim a Base result, RTL correctness, verification success, synthesis/PPA, arbitrary-text demo completion, hardware emulation, or board deployment from static package checks
claim_boundary: This replacement batch defines one marker-free static repair node and one separately authorized future execution node. It creates no V20 package, acceptance, runtime state, authority, credential, payload access, evaluator execution, Base result, RTL modification, stage transition, verification result, synthesis/PPA result, chat-demo result, FPGA result, or U280 deployment result.
